feeding_claim.verbatim: We do not use antibiotics and we do not feed any corn or soy to any of our livestock, including the poultry!

notes: Verified 2026-11-22 against homepage, products and contact pages. Homepage quote corrected to the full sentence. Dairy cows are 100% grass-fed a2a2 Jerseys; pigs and poultry pastured with no corn or soy. Beef appears only in the page title, so not listed. On-farm pickup by appointment and delivery to Crestview, Fort Walton Beach and Niceville. Cheese image says it is made with raw milk and labeled for non-human consumption; Florida allows raw milk sales only as pet food.
